resource: Raw heap-backed ParameterStatus key/value entries retained by the first-slice production root profile
allocation_impact: Do not allocate or retain a raw ParameterStatus map entry. Parse needed data from the already bounded message; only normalized server_version_num: Option<u32> may survive. Unknown/unneeded statuses are discarded.
boundary_tests: 0 raw retained entries after configured PostgreSQL 18.6 startup/status processing

Repeated unknown/unneeded ParameterStatus messages do not increase retained entry count
notes: This is a retention ceiling, not a ban on receiving PostgreSQL ParameterStatus messages. The raw message remains subject to DFR-PG-BACKEND-MESSAGE-BYTES.
